alignment: Direct PDF page-number alignment; canonical pages 1–109 compared with Library pages 1–109.
normalization: For each page, pdftotext -layout; collapse all whitespace to single spaces; calculate SHA-256 over UTF-8 normalized text; compare digest and normalized character count.
interpretation: The 109 common pages have identical normalized extracted text. This does not prove identical page images, layout, diagrams, typography, byte identity, untouched publisher-original provenance, or pedagogical equivalence.
provenance: Library-side fingerprints were generated from the user-provided Library PDF. The canonical-side fingerprints were generated by GitHub Actions from the Ministry-hosted PDF. The comparison was independently recomputed in this session.
